notes.title: Autumn Sale 25% Off
notes.content:
Take a trip on autumn colors. Get 25% off ENCYCLE for a limited time!

ENJOY a years worth of updates and added content at a fall discount.

- Sync with your own music
- Procedural level creation
- Custom Levels
- Graphical Upgrades

notes.title: Bring your own audio stream!
notes.content:
[h1]Visualize anything[/h1]

You can now visualize and play any audio stream by feeding audio directly from your microphone!

You can of course still load up a mp3 or enjoy the OST, but now also use any audio you please through microphone input.

And as always, thank you for playing!

notes.title: New Stuff!
notes.content:
A lot of changes incoming.

[list]
[*] Improved level algorithm, more pleasant level puzzles.
[*] Improved graphics.
[*] More sounds
[*] Tweaked UI (health bar)
[*] Lots of small improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Copernican Revolution
notes.content:
[h1]Let's get bouncing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801181/a2d9acee4546130ccc4fc74091a96204e1349a96.png[/img]
A [b]major[/b] update coming into early access here today as I'm creeping ever nearer a final release. In this rambunctious release you will find:

[list]
[*] Friggin Laserbeams! (Aka psychic weaponry)
[*] A cornucopia of kaleidoscopic graphics
[*] The ability to load your own music (and play it!)
[*] A re-vamped level progression system
[*] New GUI
[*] Tons and tons of small bug-fixes!
[/list]

So, what's next?

Before a proper release the following are due for an update:
[list]
[*] Improved level-layout algorithm
[*] Improved enemy and point layout algorithm
[*] Better UI for weapons
[/list]

And once those are done! It's [b]RELASE TIME (finally)[/b]

In the mean time:
Love you all.  
Be safe.

notes.title: ENCYCLE Your Music
notes.content:
[h1]Let The Beat Drop[/h1]

A lot of new polish and feature is coming to ENCYCLE these days! Among them a feature that I've been wanting to add for a long long time, but dreaded the workload. [b]Well, I dread no more!![/b] Why? Because it's IM-PLE-MENTED!

It's now possible to import your own tunes into ENCYCLE, and have the environment twist,bump, shake, and flash-around to whatever you're grooving on.

This feature is part of a major release (the major release???), which is due [b]soon![/b]

Can't wait to show ya!

notes.title: Self-Revealing Phenomenological Structure
notes.content:
[b]This is a big update![/b]

[list]
[*] A lot of improvements have been made to the level generation algorithm. 
[*] Visuals and audio have been tweaked.
[*] Lots of effects have been added. 
[/list]
[b]What's next[/b]

[list]
[*] More audio-visual effects.
[*] Load your own tracks
[/list]

notes.title: Extended Epistemological Guarantees and other bugfixes, v.02
notes.content:
Hi!

This patch includes among other things:

[list]
[*] Fixes for the main-menu (resolution should be easier to manage )
[*] Pause Menu
[*] Powerline is no longer left dangling.
[*] (Hopefully) big FPS improvements.
[/list]

The game is now using a custom occluder which hides objects that are not seen by the camera, this could lead to objejcts popping in, and it will be addressed in a later patch.

notes.title: Decreasing Ontological Friction And Other Minor Tweaks, patch 0.1
notes.content:
This patch addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Framerate Should be improved as the occluder now kicks in and some objects were decreased in complexity.
[*] Minimum supported resolution 1024x768
[*] Fixed "jump line" being visible when jumping was not possible.
[/list]
